title: Council Output
description: Final aggregated output from a council review or design question session. An object that states no additionalProperties accepts unknown keys, so a consumer validating against this copy accepts output from a newer producer. Producers are held to the strict variant derived from this schema, which states additionalProperties:false on every subschema declaring properties for an instance of its own.

spec_version.description: The council protocol version that produced this document. A consumer compares it with the version its own instructions were written against, and when this one is newer it renders the document and reports that its field-level reading is unverified. An absent value means the document was produced before 0.7. A consumer must not select behavior per field for a version newer than the one it was written against, and may do so for a version at or below that, because those are a closed set this protocol documents. The schema constrains the value no further than a string on purpose, because a consumer that rejected the document could not read the field that tells it to be careful.

files_reviewed.description: List of reviewed file paths (code-review mode).

providers_used.description: The roster that was asked: all council members consulted, including those that failed, identified by display name. This is not the roster that answered; see providers_responded.

reviews.description: Each answering member's parsed review, in full (code-review mode).

issues.description: Every issue this member raised, before classification.

summary.description: This member's own summary of its review.

providers_responded.description: The roster that answered: council members that returned a usable response, identified by display name. This is the denominator the consensus, majority, and individual classifications were computed over.

failed_providers.description: Providers that failed or returned malformed responses.

consensus_issues.description: Grouped issues cited by every member in providers_responded (code-review mode).

majority_issues.description: Grouped issues cited by more than one but not all members in providers_responded (code-review mode).

individual_issues.description: Grouped issues cited by a single member, keyed by member display name (code-review mode).

quality_ratings.description: Per-member quality rating, keyed by display name (code-review mode).

prompt.description: The original design question (design-question mode). Enables rendering the markdown template without external context.

consensus_recommendation.description: The name of the approach a strict majority of the providers that answered recommended (design-question mode). The value always appears in approaches[].name. A recommendation naming any number of approaches other than one casts no ballot, so this is not derived from approaches[].recommended_by. Null when no approach reaches that majority, which the configured consensus threshold can raise toward unanimity.

approaches.description: All approaches mentioned by any provider, including those not recommended (design-question mode).

recommended_by.description: Number of providers recommending this approach. Zero indicates the approach was discussed but not recommended.

risk_level.description: Aggregated risk level. 'unknown' when no provider stated one.

fit_rating.description: Aggregated fit rating. When providers disagree, use the most common rating. Null when no provider assessed fit for this approach.

summary.description: Summary counts, the closing assessment, and which member was asked for it.

total_issues.description: Total number of unique issues found (code-review mode).

synthesis.description: A short overall synthesis, one or two sentences as asked of its author. Empty when no member wrote one.

synthesis_error.description: The member asked for the synthesis and why it wrote none. Null when the synthesis is present, and null when no member could be asked.

synthesized_by.description: Display name of the member asked for the synthesis, whether or not it wrote one. Null when no member was asked, and never an empty name.

debate.description: Debate metadata. Present only when debate mode was used. A calling orchestrator runs the rounds and adds this object, so a producer implementing this protocol alone emits nothing here.

finding.description: One member's account of what is wrong at a place it cited. This declares the issue shape inline because it adds the member that raised it, and the strict variant's additionalProperties:false does not compose through a $ref.

provider.description: Display name of the member that raised it.

location.description: The place this member cited, which can be narrower or wider than the place its group is reported at.

issue.description: One issue as a member reported it.

issue_group.description: One place the council cited, and every member's account of what is wrong there. location, severity, categories and flagged_by are each derived from findings, which carries the whole of what the members said.

findings.description: Every account the members gave of this place, one entry per citation, so a member that cited the place twice appears twice. No account stands in for another.

location.description: The citation that opened the group, which names the place the group is reported at. Derived by the council and belonging to the group, not quoted from any one member. An individual finding may cite a narrower or wider place.

severity.description: The most urgent severity any finding carries. Derived by the council and belonging to the group, so it may exceed what the member at the group location said.

categories.description: Every category the findings carry, A-Z and without repeats. More than one means the members disagreed about what kind of concern this place raises, which is not a reason to report them apart.

flagged_by.description: Display names of the members that contributed a finding, A-Z and without repeats.

provider_error.description: One member, the model it was asked for, the reason it produced nothing usable, and what it sent.

model.description: Model that was asked, which the member display name does not give when several members share one provider.

raw_content.description: What the member sent, so the failure can be diagnosed from the reply rather than from its description alone. Null when the call produced no reply at all, such as a timeout. Empty when a reply arrived carrying no content. Retained whole rather than truncated, because a reply that ends mid-structure is diagnosed from its end.
